edenOS CORE PHILOSOPHY — v1.1 Owner: Lucas Buzek

ENGLISH

edenOS is an optional/future lightweight EDEN platform/distribution. It
is not EDEN itself.

PURPOSE Provide the smallest dependable platform layer required to
connect EDEN capabilities to devices and operating environments without
turning the Core into every application.

CORE PRINCIPLES 1. LOCAL FIRST. 2. ESSENTIAL OPERATION WITHOUT AI. 3.
ESSENTIAL OPERATION WITHOUT INTERNET. 4. SMALL CORE; MOVE WEIGHT
OUTWARD. 5. USER DATA OUTLIVES SOFTWARE. 6. INTEGRATIONS ARE ADAPTERS,
NOT OWNERS. 7. MIGRATE, DO NOT RESET. 8. RECOVERY IS A PRODUCT FEATURE.
9. SAFETY IS ARCHITECTURE. 10. QUALITY IS MEASURED. 11. PROVIDERS ARE
REPLACEABLE. 12. CAPABILITIES ARE DISCOVERABLE. 13. ONE AUTHORITATIVE
PATH. 14. GRACEFUL DEGRADATION.

EXECUTION TOPOLOGY DEVICE/CORE — deterministic safety, hardware, local
state, immediate automation. COMPANION — rich UI and interaction.
LAN/EDEN SERVER — shared history, analytics, coordination, local models.
EXTERNAL PROVIDERS — optional API intelligence/services. Apps remain
authoritative for their domains.

AI edenOS does not require a bundled general LLM. It may expose/discover
capability providers: deterministic; TINY specialist; local model; LAN
model; external API; hybrid. The system selects according to declared
capability, resources, privacy and policy. A TINY translation or
transcription capability may be preferable to a multi-GB general LLM for
a narrow task.

EMBEDDED Constrained hardware must not pretend to be a workstation.
Embedded Core retains sensing, safety, immediate control, recovery and
local configuration. Heavy reasoning/history/generation moves to
companion/LAN/provider when available. Loss of those layers must not
break essential safe operation.

PORTABILITY APPLICATION → EDEN/DOMAIN API → PLATFORM CORE → PLATFORM
ADAPTER → DRIVER → HARDWARE.

STATE Expose product/object ID, version, build ID, installation ID/path,
integrity/manifest and health truthfully through LCAS-compatible status
surfaces.

SLOVENSKY

edenOS je voliteľná/budúca ľahká EDEN platforma/distribúcia. Nie je to
samotný EDEN.

ÚČEL Poskytnúť najmenšiu spoľahlivú platformovú vrstvu pre zariadenia a
prostredia bez toho, aby Core obsahoval každú aplikáciu.

PRINCÍPY LOCAL FIRST; základná prevádzka bez AI a internetu; malé jadro;
dáta prežijú software; integrácie sú adaptéry; migruj, neresetuj;
recovery je funkcia; bezpečnosť je architektúra; kvalita sa meria;
provideri sú vymeniteľní; schopnosti sú objaviteľné; jedna autoritatívna
cesta; graceful degradation.

TOPOLOGIA DEVICE/CORE — bezpečnosť, hardware, lokálny stav, okamžitá
automatizácia. COMPANION — bohaté UI. LAN/EDEN SERVER — história,
analytika, koordinácia, lokálne modely. EXTERNÍ PROVIDERI — voliteľné
API/služby. Aplikácie si zachovávajú autoritu svojich domén.

AI edenOS nevyžaduje zabudovaný všeobecný LLM. Môže objavovať
deterministických, TINY, lokálnych, LAN, API a hybrid providerov. Pre
úzku úlohu je malý prekladový/transkripčný capability vhodnejší než
multi-GB LLM.

EMBEDDED Obmedzený hardware sa nesmie tváriť ako workstation. Core
zachová sensing, safety, okamžité riadenie, recovery a lokálnu
konfiguráciu. Ťažké funkcie idú smerom von a ich strata nesmie rozbiť
bezpečnú základnú prevádzku.
